lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12-14 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines traverse the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section, with closer intervals observed towards the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the sixth vertical line from the posterior, approximately mid-torso in vertical orientation.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines are discontinuous, transitioning into discrete circular blobs towards the ventral-posterior boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 8-10 white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, ventral to the terminal vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four distinct spots on the upper hind limb align in a diagonal trajectory following the musculature from the mid-haunch toward the posterior stifle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white transverse band on the lower front and hind legs above the hooves; large, rounded ears with white internal hair markings; a prominent white patch on the anterior throat.
